497:t_019:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「There is a reason! I'm with $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and you're with the $$地球連邦$$!」

497:t_019:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel tried to save both $$スペースノイド$$s and $$アースノイド$$s! We're doing the same!」

497:t_019:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's sophistry! How could anyone do that!?」

497:t_019:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel and all of us believe it's possible! Are you saying it isn't!?」

497:t_019:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$! $$ギュネイ$$ is wavering! Now...!」

497:t_019:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I understand! I'll stop him and take away his ability to fight!」

497:t_019:11.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you can do it, $$カミーユ$$!」

497:t_019:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Here I come, $$ギュネイ$$! I won't lose to you while you're full of doubts!」

497:t_020:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up! I have no intention of listening to you!」

497:t_020:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass you, and eventually surpass $$フル・フロンタル$$, too!」

497:t_020:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Would you be satisfied with so little!?」

497:t_020:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you defeat me, will you be able to save the $$スペースノイド$$s as you wish!? Answer me, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_020:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you hate me for betraying you, I'll let you strike me down! But I won't give the name $$赤い彗星$$ to a man with no vision beyond that!」

497:t_020:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Let's do this, $$カミーユ$$! By stopping him, we'll make him acknowledge his own doubts!」

497:t_020:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you can do it, $$シャア$$!」

497:t_020:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! This is the last thing I can do for you!」

497:t_021:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「Is this as far as I go...!?」

497:t_021:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「I know what you're trying to say, Colonel. ...I suppose it's time for me to call it quits, too.」

497:t_021:3.en:
$$レズン$$
「From here on, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the Federation don't matter... I'll do things my own way, too.」

497:t_022:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「I think she understood what the Colonel has in mind.」

497:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$シャア$$... You have to settle things for their sake, too...)

497:t_100:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll settle this, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_100:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! If our words can't reach you anymore...!」

497:t_100:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll stop you! That is my duty!」

497:t_101:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come on, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_101:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$! We want to talk to you!」

497:t_101:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent! Fighting is all there is between us!」

497:t_101:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even so! If we keep fighting like this, humanity has no future!」

497:t_101:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「We'll grapple with him, $$カミーユ$$! We must make contact with $$ギュネイ$$, even if we have to use some force!」

497:t_102:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll settle this, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! We'll stop you from fighting while you're full of doubts!」

497:t_102:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「We've said all we can! $$ギュネイ$$! Now we'll subdue you by force!」

497:t_103:0.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Are you still going to fight!?」

497:t_103:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「It's you, $$シン$$! What do you know about me!?」

497:t_103:2.en:
$$シン$$
「You can't decide what's right for yourself and just charge ahead on pride and emotion. You're just like I used to be!」

497:t_103:3.en:
$$シン$$
「That's why I'll stop you! I can't stand to watch this anymore!」

497:t_104:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_104:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$マリーダ$$! I'm not listening to someone who betrayed $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

497:t_104:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Condemn me all you want! And if you remain in $$ネオ・ジオン$$ out of conviction, I'll face you with all my strength!」

497:t_104:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But you're lying to yourself now! I don't want to fight someone so sad!」

497:t_105:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of my way, $$クェス$$!」

497:t_105:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「I won't, $$ギュネイ$$! ...You said you'd protect me!」

497:t_105:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「So this time, I'll protect you, $$ギュネイ$$! If you keep fighting like this, you'll break!」

497:t_105:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「This isn't like you, $$ギュネイ$$! If you're going to dodge the issue, get out of that machine right now!」

497:t_106:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! The name $$赤い彗星$$ belongs to the Colonel!」

497:t_106:1.en:
$$シャア$$
($$フル・フロンタル$$ has the power to draw people's hearts to him so completely...)

497:t_107:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I've found you, $$角割れ$$! Today you'll finally hand that machine over to the Colonel!」

497:t_107:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've decided to face $$ラプラスの箱$$! To do that, I'll protect the $$ユニコーン$$ no matter what!」

497:t_108:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Come to think of it, your defection from $$ネオ・ジオン$$ was quite convenient, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

497:t_108:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Now I can dispose of you legally!」

497:t_108:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...I never realized fighting for petty personal feelings was this ridiculous...」

497:t_108:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I won't let you, $$アンジェロ$$! My real fight starts here!」

497:t_109:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$! Are you going to get in my way, too!?」

497:t_109:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm not fighting for such a trivial reason!」

497:t_109:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're a mere $$強化人間$$!」

497:t_109:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You blindly follow $$フル・フロンタル$$, just like a $$強化人間$$ with no purpose in fighting! I won't let a man like that kill me!」

497:t_110:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「This guy...! Has he powered up his machine!?」

497:t_110:1.en:
$n
「It seems we're both still being pushed around by our new machines!」

497:t_110:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't lump me in with an amateur like you!」

497:t_110:3.en:
$n
「It's about time I stopped being a fledgling!」

497:t_110:4.en:
$n
「I'll prove it by mastering this $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

497:t_111:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'll show you how the powered-up $$サバーニャ$$ fights!」

497:t_111:1.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$ is fired up. $$ロックオン$$ is fired up.」

497:t_111:2.en:
$$青ハロ$$
「The target is locked. The target is locked.」
